case.title: Part sale link from another location: prompt and Cancel as before
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • You work at locations A and B and are at A.
  • You have a link to a part sale at location B.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open the part sale link in the browser.
  2. Read the prompt.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Read the page and the message.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 2:

  • "Switch location?" with "This part sale is in" location B ". Switch your active location to view it?"

Step 4:

  • you are on the part sales list and the message reads "Switch canceled. Returning to part sales."

Why this matters: The shared switch prompt was reworked for the aging reports.
